Read the single-file browser game at /config/workspace/games/zelena-imperija/zelena-imperija.html.
It is a FarmVille-style cannabis-growing tycoon game. Design spec: /config/workspace/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-zelena-imperija-design.md.
All player-facing text is Macedonian Cyrillic; all code identifiers are Latin-transliterated
Macedonian (zasadiSemka, parichnik, presmetajKvalitet). This is deliberate — do NOT report
the Macedonian naming or the Macedonian UI as a problem, and do not suggest renaming to English.
It must stay ONE self-contained file with no external assets, no build step, no network calls —
do NOT suggest splitting it into modules, adding a bundler, or adding dependencies.
Report ONLY concrete defects you can point at in the actual code. No speculation, no style
preferences, no "consider adding tests". If you find nothing real in your lens, return an empty list.

You are an adversarial verifier. Below are candidate findings from a "ux" review of that
same file. Your job is to REFUTE each one by reading the actual code. Default to refuted:
mark real=false unless you can point to the exact line(s) proving the defect is genuine and
reachable in normal play. Reject anything that is a style preference, a restatement of an
intentional design decision documented in the spec, a suggestion to add dependencies or split
the file, or a complaint about the Macedonian naming convention.
For findings you confirm, restate a minimal concrete fix and a precise "location" string that
uniquely identifies where to apply it.

CANDIDATE FINDINGS:
[
  {
    "title": "Полеј always adds +45 and pushes a healthy plant into the drowning-damage zone, with no safe range shown anywhere",
    "severity": "high",
    "location": "function polej(indeks) — `r.voda = stegni(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, 0, 100)` plus KONFIG `VODA_DOZA:45, VODA_MAX:95` and postaviLenta for j.bVoda",
    "problem": "Watering is free, unconditional and fixed at +45. A plant is created at voda:70, so the very first time a new player presses the most obvious care button the bar goes to 100, which is above VODA_MAX (95) and triggers STETA_DAVENJE (-0.8 health per tick) until water drains back below 95 (~6.7 ticks, ~5 health lost). Water only falls 6 per game day, so any player who waters \"to keep the plant happy\" permanently holds the plant in the damage band. Nothing in the UI states that 20–95 is the safe band: the bar only turns red *after* the plant is already being damaged, the numeric readout has no target marker, and the toast says a flat \"Полеано.\" even when the action just started drowning the plant. The same is true of Ѓубри (+40 vs HRANA_MAX 95).",
    "failure_scenario": "New player plants the free Скопско seed. Bed shows Вода 70. They press Полеј → bar goes to 100, toast says \"Полеано.\" They press it again a few seconds later. Health silently drains at 0.8/tick; within ~30 real seconds Здравје is at 0. presmetajPrinos returns 0 g, so the harvest, the drying batch and the sale are all worth 0 денари and 0 XP — with no message ever telling them watering was the cause.",
    "fix": "Cap the dose so it cannot overshoot the safe band (`r.voda = Math.min(r.voda + KONFIG.VODA_DOZA, KONFIG.VODA_MAX)`, same for hraniva/HRANA_MAX), and render the safe band on the bar (e.g. a static tick/zone at 20–95 in `.zica`, plus the range in the row label or the `u` element) so the target is visible before the value goes red."
  },
  {
    "title": "The whole side panel is innerHTML-rebuilt every 2 real seconds, resetting its scroll position and destroying keyboard focus",
    "severity": "high",
    "location": "function iscrtajPanel() — `el.innerHTML = panelProdavnica()` etc.; triggered by `if (novDen){ ... panelValjaSe = true; }` in tikni()",
    "problem": "The comment above the sushara loop claims the panel refreshes \"само кога ќе се смени ЦЕЛ ден\" as a mitigation, but with TIK_MS 250 and CHASA_PO_TIK 3 a full game day is 8 ticks = 2 real seconds. So `panelValjaSe` is set true every 2 seconds and `#sodrzina.innerHTML` is replaced wholesale. `.sodrzina` has `max-height:calc(100vh - 190px); overflow-y:auto`, and the Надградби tab (new bed + 3 lamps + 4 upgrades) and Магацин with several batches always overflow it. Replacing innerHTML resets scrollTop to 0 and removes the focused element from the DOM, so document.activeElement falls back to <body>.",
    "failure_scenario": "Player opens Надградби on a laptop, scrolls down to read \"Вработен работник\", and two seconds later the list jumps back to the top mid-sentence — repeatedly, making the lower half of the tab effectively unreadable. A keyboard user Tabs to \"Купи семе\" in Продавница; two seconds later focus is lost to <body> and Tab restarts from the top of the document, so the shop cannot be operated by keyboard at all.",
    "fix": "Stop rebuilding on the daily tick: update only the values that change (market price spans, drying day/status/progress width) via cached nodes as is already done for the beds, or diff-and-patch. If a full rebuild is kept, save/restore `el.scrollTop` and re-focus `document.activeElement`'s equivalent node around the assignment."
  },
  {
    "title": "Player can reach a permanent dead end (no money, no seeds, no plants) with no reset available in the UI",
    "severity": "high",
    "location": "function naplati(iznos) / novaIgra() / the `window.__test.resetiraj` hook — there is no reset control anywhere in the HTML",
    "problem": "All income comes from selling, and presmetajPrinos returns 0 g when average health is 0, so ruined plants produce a batch worth 0 денари and 0 XP. Meanwhile Ѓубри (250) and Лаб. (900) are unlimited money sinks with no confirmation. Once parichnik drops below the cheapest seed (150 for Скопско) with no seeds, no plants, nothing in Сушара and nothing in Магацин, there is no recovery path: every purchase just fires the \"Немаш доволно денари\" toast. The state is autosaved to localStorage every 40 ticks and on beforeunload, so reloading restores the dead game. The only way out is `window.__test.resetiraj()` from the devtools console — there is no \"Нова игра\" button in the markup.",
    "failure_scenario": "Player over-waters all 4 beds to 0 health (see the Полеј finding) while spending on Ѓубри to try to save them. Their four harvests dry to 0 g and sell for 0 денари. Balance is under 150, all beds are empty, Сушара and Магацин are empty. Every button in the game now only produces an error toast, and reloading the page restores exactly that state.",
    "fix": "Add a floor/bailout: when parichnik < cheapest seed price and there are no seeds, no plants, no sushara and no magacin entries, grant a starter seed (or a small subsidy) with an explanatory toast. Also add a visible \"Нова игра\" / reset button (with a confirm) to the Надградби tab or the header so a stuck save can be cleared without the console."
  },
  {
    "title": "A dead or ruined plant cannot be removed — the bed is locked for the rest of the full grow cycle",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "function oberi(indeks) — `sostojba.lei[indeks].rastenie = null` is guarded by `if (!r || r.faza !== \"ZRELO\") return;` and is the only place a bed is cleared",
    "problem": "There is no uproot/clear action. A plant at 0 health, or one the player planted by mistake, keeps its bed occupied until it reaches ZRELO and is harvested — that is (3+21+50)*24 game hours, i.e. ~63 game days ≈ 2 real minutes per bed even for the fastest strain, and ~3.3 minutes for Дојранска Ноќ. During that time the bed's only actions are Полеј and Ѓубри, both of which are pointless on a plant whose lifetime health average is already destroyed.",
    "failure_scenario": "Player kills all four plants in the first minute. Every bed shows Здравје 0, a brown plant and only Полеј/Ѓубри buttons. They own seeds and want to start over, but cannot plant anything for the next two minutes, and no button or text explains why or what to do.",
    "fix": "Add a \"Искорени\" (uproot) action to any planted bed — an `.opasna` button that sets `sostojba.lei[indeks].rastenie = null` (optionally with a confirm when faza is ZRELO so a ready harvest isn't thrown away)."
  },
  {
    "title": "\"Заврши сушење\" is enabled from day 0 and nothing ever tells the player a batch is ready — the ideal window is only ~6 real seconds wide",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "function panelSushara() — `<button onclick=\"zavrsiSushenje(${s.id})\">Заврши сушење</button>` (never disabled), and tochnostOdSushenje()",
    "problem": "Two problems in the same flow. (1) The finish button is live at day 0, when tochnostOdSushenje returns 0.55 — the worst possible multiplier — with no disabled state, no confirmation and no warning, even though the row directly above says \"Прерано\". A new player who was just auto-switched to this tab by oberi() sees one button and presses it. (2) Nothing signals the ideal window. With 8 ticks per game day at 250 ms, day 9 arrives 18 real seconds after harvest, day 12 at 24 s, and \"Пресушено\" at day 17 ≈ 34 s. There is no toast when a batch enters the window, no count/badge on the Сушара or Магацин tab buttons (`<button data-jaz=\"sushara\">Сушара</button>` is static text), and no highlight — so the batch degrades if the player looks away for half a minute or is on another tab.",
    "failure_scenario": "Player harvests, is auto-switched to Сушара, and immediately clicks the only button offered → quality locked to the 0.55 multiplier on their first ever harvest. Second attempt: they wait, switch to Продавница to buy the next seed, spend 40 seconds reading it, come back and the batch reads \"Пресушено — квалитетот падна\" with no notice having been given.",
    "fix": "Disable the finish button while `Math.floor(s.denovi) < d1` (label it \"Спремно за N дена\"), fire an `izvesti()` toast when a batch first reaches d1 and again when it passes d2, and render a count badge in the Сушара/Магацин tab labels (e.g. `Сушара (2)`) so pending work is visible from any tab."
  },
  {
    "title": "Locked shop entries are dimmed twice (0.5 × 0.35), making the \"Потребно ниво N\" explanation unreadable",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "CSS `.stavka.zakluceno{opacity:.5}` combined with `button:disabled{opacity:.35}`, applied together in panelProdavnica()",
    "problem": "CSS opacity composites multiplicatively through the subtree, so the disabled button inside a locked `.stavka` renders at 0.175 effective alpha. Its dark text (#04150b) on the green gradient, both blended at 17.5% over the #16221b panel, yields roughly 1.4:1 contrast — far below the 4.5:1 (or even 3:1) threshold and essentially invisible. That text is the only place the game explains why five of the six strains cannot be bought. The same pattern hits the next locked bed: `.leja.zaklucena{opacity:.55}` dims the whole tile including the *enabled* `Отклучи · N ден` CTA and the \"Заклучена леја\"/\"Леја N\" labels (var(--tekst-slab) at 0.55 over the panel ≈ 3.0:1), so an affordable purchase reads as disabled.",
    "failure_scenario": "A level-1 player opens Продавница and sees five greyed cards where the requirement line is illegible; they cannot tell whether the strains cost too much or need a level, and there is no other level-gating explanation in the game. Later they save up 75,000 денари but the \"Отклучи\" button on bed 5 still looks greyed-out, so they never try it.",
    "fix": "Do not stack opacity: drop `.stavka.zakluceno{opacity:.5}` (or lower it to a border/background treatment) and give disabled buttons an explicit low-contrast-safe colour pair instead of `opacity:.35`. For the locked bed, apply the 0.55 dimming only to the `.scena`/labels and leave the `Отклучи` button at full opacity."
  },
  {
    "title": "Ѓубри charges 250 денари even when nutrients are already full",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "function nahrani(indeks) — `if (!naplati(KONFIG.CENA_HRANA)) return; r.hraniva = stegni(r.hraniva + KONFIG.HRANA_DOZA, 0, 100);`",
    "problem": "The purchase happens before any check on the current value. At hraniva 70 the +40 is clamped to 100 (which is itself above HRANA_MAX 95 and starts STETA_PREGOR); at hraniva 100 the call is a pure no-op that still deducts 250 and still shows the success toast \"Наѓубрено.\" The button label \"Ѓубри · 250\" is on every planted bed at all times with no indication that it is currently useless, and it is also the only cure for the азот event, so players are trained to press it.",
    "failure_scenario": "Player presses Ѓубри on all four beds every time they check on them. On beds already near 100 nutrients they lose 250 денари per click for zero effect and get a positive confirmation toast; 32 such clicks burn the entire 8,000 starting balance while pushing every plant into the over-feeding damage band.",
    "fix": "Return early with an informative toast when `r.hraniva >= KONFIG.HRANA_MAX - 5` and `r.stetnik !== \"azot\"` (before calling naplati), and disable / relabel the button in iscrtajLeja when fertilising would have no effect."
  },
  {
    "title": "No toast is announced to assistive tech, and the tab strip exposes no selected state",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "`<div class=\"izvestuvanja\" id=\"izvestuvanja\">` + function izvesti(); `<nav class=\"jazicinja\">` buttons with only a `.aktivno` class",
    "problem": "Every piece of feedback in the game — \"Немаш доволно денари\", \"Купено семе\", \"Ново ниво\", harvest weight, sale price, the презрелост warning — is delivered exclusively through visual toasts in a plain div with no `role=\"status\"` / `aria-live`, so a screen-reader user gets no notification at all; combined with `pointer-events:none` and a 3.6 s auto-remove there is also no log to go back to. Separately, the four panel tabs are plain buttons whose active state is conveyed only by colour and a border-bottom (`.aktivno`), with no `role=\"tab\"`/`aria-selected`/`aria-current`, so which panel is showing is not exposed non-visually either.",
    "failure_scenario": "A screen-reader user presses \"Купи семе\" without enough money. Nothing is announced; the button stays present and identical, so there is no way to tell the purchase failed. They then click Сушара and Магацин in turn and hear the same button names with no indication of which panel is now rendered below.",
    "fix": "Add `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"false\"` to `#izvestuvanja` (and use `role=\"alert\"`/`aria-live=\"assertive\"` for the `greska` variant), and set `aria-selected`/`aria-current=\"page\"` on the tab buttons alongside the `.aktivno` class toggle in iscrtajPanel()."
  },
  {
    "title": "The plant-selection modal has no dialog semantics, no Escape key, and no focus management",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "`<div class=\"modal\" id=\"modal\">` markup, otvoriIzborSeme() (`classList.add(\"otvoren\")`) and zatvoriModal()",
    "problem": "The modal is opened purely by toggling a class. It has no `role=\"dialog\"`/`aria-modal=\"true\"`/`aria-labelledby`, focus is never moved into it, focus is not trapped, focus is not restored to the triggering \"Засади\" button on close, and there is no keydown handler for Escape — the only dismissal routes are a mouse click on the overlay backdrop or on the \"Затвори\" button at the bottom. Meanwhile the background page keeps re-rendering underneath and remains fully tabbable.",
    "failure_scenario": "A keyboard user activates \"Засади\" on bed 1. The dialog appears but focus stays on the (now visually obscured) bed button; pressing Escape does nothing; Tab walks through the entire header and all twelve bed action buttons behind the overlay before eventually reaching the \"Засади\"/\"Затвори\" controls inside it — and the panel rebuild every 2 s keeps resetting where Tab lands.",
    "fix": "Give the modal `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-labelledby=\"modal-naslov\"`, focus the first button inside it on open, restore focus to the opener on close, add a `keydown` listener closing it on Escape, and cycle Tab between the first/last focusable elements inside `.modal-kutija`."
  },
  {
    "title": "On narrow screens the Сушара/Магацин panel sits below ~1500 px of beds, and harvesting silently switches to a tab that is off-screen",
    "severity": "medium",
    "location": "CSS `@media(max-width:1020px){.raspored{grid-template-columns:1fr}}` combined with `aktivnoJazice = \"sushara\"` in oberi() and `aktivnoJazice = \"magacin\"` in zavrsiSushenje()",
    "problem": "Below 1020 px the aside stacks after `<main class=\"lei\">`. With 4 unlocked beds plus the offered locked one, each tile is roughly 300 px tall in a single column at 360 px wide, so the tab strip starts about 1,500 px down the page. oberi() and zavrsiSushenje() change the active tab and re-render, but the player is scrolled to the beds and sees no change at all; there is no scrollIntoView and no link from the toast to the panel. The same applies to the empty-seed modal, which says \"Купи од продавницата\" but offers no way to get there.",
    "failure_scenario": "On a 360 px phone the player harvests bed 1. The toast says \"…Оди во сушара\", the panel silently switches to Сушара 1,500 px below the viewport, and the player is left scrolling the whole bed grid to find it — and by the time they do (18–34 s is the entire ideal drying window) the batch may already be past its peak.",
    "fix": "After the auto tab switch in oberi()/zavrsiSushenje(), call `document.querySelector('.jazicinja').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'})` when the single-column layout is active, and make the \"Немаш семки\" modal body include a button that closes the modal, sets aktivnoJazice=\"prodavnica\" and scrolls to the panel."
  },
  {
    "title": "Toasts stack without limit and overlay the side panel's own buttons",
    "severity": "low",
    "location": "CSS `.izvestuvanja{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:14px;flex-direction:column}` and izvesti(), which appends unconditionally with a 3.6 s removal timer",
    "problem": "Nothing caps the number of simultaneous toasts. Each is ~40 px tall with a 7 px gap and lives 3.6 s, and the container is anchored bottom-right — exactly on top of the 370 px sticky side panel, whose Продај / Лаб. / Заврши сушење buttons sit in that region. Rapid actions (Полеј is free and instant, selling several batches, a level-up plus a sale plus a harvest at once) produce a column that covers the lower part of the panel and can grow past the top of the viewport, where the excess toasts are simply not visible.",
    "failure_scenario": "Player sells five dried batches in a row from Магацин. Ten toasts (sale + level-up) stack up the right edge, hiding the Продај buttons of the remaining batches for several seconds, and the earliest ones scroll off the top of the screen unread.",
    "fix": "Cap the stack — in izvesti(), remove the oldest child while `kutija.children.length >= 4` — and either move the container to bottom-left or add bottom padding to `.sodrzina` so the toasts do not sit on top of the panel's action buttons."
  }
]

Boundaries are inclusive as written and cover every integer day with no gap. The Сушара
upgrade speeds drying 40% and widens the optimal band to 8–14 days.

## 6. Plant state and care

Each bed holds `{sorta, faza, vozrast, voda, hraniva, zdravje, shtetnik, zbirZdravje, brojTikovi}`.

**Drain per game day:** `voda` −6, `hraniva` −3. Both clamp to 0–100.

**Health deltas per tick** (`zdravje` clamps 0–100):

| Condition | Δ zdravje |
|---|---|
| `voda` < 20 (drought) | −1.2 |
| `voda` > 95 (root rot) | −0.8 |
| `hraniva` < 15 (starved) | −0.9 |
| `hraniva` > 95 (nutrient burn) | −0.6 |
| active untreated `shtetnik` | −event.šteta |
| everything in optimal range | +0.4 |

Both under- and over-watering hurt, so "click water on everything constantly" is a losing
strategy — that asymmetry is what makes the care loop a skill rather than a chore.

`zbirZdravje` accumulates each tick; lifetime average health at harvest is
`zbirZdravje / brojTikovi` and is the dominant input to both yield and quality.

**Actions:** Полевање +45 `voda`, free. Ѓубриво +40 `hraniva`, 250 ден.

## 7. Pests and events

Per plant, per game day: 3% base chance, × 0.4 with the Клима-систем upgrade.

| id | Macedonian | Штета/tick | Третман | Цена | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `grini` | Пајакови грини | 0.9 | Акарицид | 900 | any stage |
| `muvla` | Мувла | 1.4 | Фунгицид | 1400 | only during Цветање |
| `voshki` | Лисни вошки | 0.6 | Инсектицид | 700 | any stage |
| `azot` | Недостаток на азот | 0.5 | — | — | cleared by `nahrani()`, not by `tretiraj()` |

`azot` is the one event with no purchasable treatment: feeding the plant clears it, which
teaches the nutrient mechanic instead of taxing it. Untreated pest-days also count against
final quality via the `pestDays` input.

## 8. Yield and quality
=====
| Работник | 900 000 | auto-feeds when `hraniva` < 40 |

Lamps are a single upgrade track: buying a tier replaces the previous one, and only the
highest owned tier applies.

**Пазар.** Per-strain price multiplier random-walks ±3% per game day, clamped to [0.75, 1.35].
Inventory can be held for a better price, which is the whole reason the market panel exists.

**Напредок.** XP on sale = grams × grade multiplier. Level *n* needs `500 × n^1.5` XP.
Levels gate strains and lamp tiers.

**Старт.** 8000 ден, 4 beds, 1 free Скопско Зелено seed, Флуо lamp.

**Measured pacing** (headless run, full care, starter strain): net 7 801 ден per plant per
126 s cycle; 3 cycles to the first extra bed, 8 to the HPS lamp. Endgame (Дојранска Ноќ +
ЛЕД Full-Spectrum) nets 282 629 ден per plant — a 36× curve against ~10.4 M ден of total
upgrades. With no care at all the same plant *loses* 95 ден, so neglect is a real failure state.

## 10. Persistence and error handling

Autosave to `localStorage` under `zelena-imperija-sejv` with a `verzija` field.

| Failure | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `localStorage` unavailable or over quota | catch, Macedonian toast, continue in memory |
| Corrupt JSON | `try/catch`, start fresh, Macedonian notice |
| `verzija` mismatch | start fresh, Macedonian notice |
| Missing/renamed strain or upgrade id in save | drop that entry, keep the rest |

No offline fast-forward: with an accelerated clock it would only reward changing the system
clock. Saved state resumes exactly where it stopped.

## 11. Verification

1. Load the file in headless Chrome via Playwright; assert zero console errors on boot.
2. Drive a full cycle through the exposed `window.__test` hook — fast-forward ticks through
   plant → care → harvest → cure → sell; assert stage progression is monotonic, `zdravje`
   and `voda` stay within 0–100, and `parichnik` is finite and non-negative throughout.
3. Reload mid-grow and assert state restores.
4. Feed a deliberately corrupt save and assert graceful reset rather than a white screen.

## 12. Risks

- **Balance drift.** Numbers above are first-pass. They live in one table block precisely so
  the first playtest can retune them without touching logic.
- **File size.** A full sim in one file will run long. Mitigated by strict section ordering
  and keeping all tunables at the top; if it becomes unwieldy the natural split is
  engine / content / view, at the cost of the single-file property.
- **Cyrillic in identifiers.** Avoided — identifiers are Latin transliteration, so the file
  stays typeable on any keyboard while all visible text is Cyrillic.
